provenance: Generated by scripts/server-data/maps.ts from vendor/dofedex/maps-2004 (map SWFs dated July 2004 or later, i.e. post-beta 1.0-era maps, NOT beta 5b arena maps). mapData is copied verbatim, except the line-of-sight bit cleared on the cells listed in losCleared (authored: unwalkable cells the map leaves bare, which this client draws as white diamonds; clearing changes no line of sight between cells a character can stand on). coverage = share of ground/object references drawn by beta 5b clips. places = placement cells per team (authored by the script: first/last cells of the largest walkable line-of-sight area where objects drawn in front do not hide a standing character).
worldProvenance: world = role-play maps of the social village (docs/server.md stage 3b), same sources; mapData verbatim. links = plate cell → [map, arrival cell]: retro_emulator, the unconditional teleport cells of vendor/starloco/scripted_cells.sql (Dofus Retro 1.39.8 emulator data) kept only where they join two map-change plates (object 1030) of these 2004 maps, both ways; the arrival cell is the plate of the destination map that teleports back. coverage = share of ground/object references drawn by the filled libraries (beta 5b clips plus the ids beta 5b lacks, taken from later archived clients: web/public/assets/swf/clips/*.fill.json, docs/assets-format.md §11). The world is the largest set of maps with coverage >= 0.95 connected by such links.
